capabilities: Record note and canvas creation and edit dates automatically
Embed an interactive history calendar in a note via a code block
Open the calendar in the right sidebar
Link calendar dates to Daily Notes for opening or creating daily notes
Remove individual history dates from hover popups
disambiguation: Not file version history or backups; it only logs creation and edit dates, with no snapshots of past content.
problem: Obsidian shows no overview of when notes were created or edited across a vault, making long-term activity and note dates hard to see.

relations.evidence: Calendar dates also integrate with Obsidian's Daily Notes core plugin.

summary: Activity tracker that records note and canvas creation and edit dates and displays them as an interactive calendar in notes or a sidebar.
